errors.evidence: The description states that the blue line for Germany begins in 1997 at a value of 4.0. According to the chart, the line begins in 1995 at a value of approximately 4.1. The value of 4.0 is explicitly annotated for the year 1997, which is not the start of the series.

The description states that the green line for Austria begins in 1997 at a value of 4.0. According to the chart, this line also begins in 1995 at a value of approximately 4.1. The description incorrectly identifies the starting point of the series.
